These SVGs intentionally use var(--ld-figure-*, fallback) semantic colors. The retained author failure records report dropped var()-stroked paths and paper regions filled black. The exact unchanged SVG bytes produce the intended dark strokes and white paper in the existing Chromium captures with resolved computed styles. This local contrast identifies the CSS-variable paint-handling mismatch in the generic Resvg preview path; it is not a claim about every resvg version or every SVG.
